source: BYOP (BUILD YOUR OWN PROGRAM - BLAZE CAMP MODEL) / 'MASTER EXERCISE LIBRARY' columns AV-AY (rows 1-17)
how_it_is_used: OBSERVED: every program tab's SETS / REPS (and, in the tracking tabs, EFFORT / 'HOW IT FELT?') column is a list data-validation pointing at these columns, always starting at row 7 so the green 'CHOOSE 👇' cell (row 7) is itself a legal value and serves as the unfilled placeholder. Ranges run to row 42, far past the last option (harmless: Google Sheets ignores blank cells in list ranges).

placeholder.note: The two hidden 'NO ACCESS' tabs pre-fill cells with the typo 'CHOSE 👇', which is NOT in any list -> every one of those 422 cells shows Google Sheets' invalid-value warning.

options.meaning_inferred: Entered in the SETS cell of an exercise row to say 'this exercise is supersetted with the exercise on the row below' (the 👇 points down). The set count then comes from the paired row. Same convention appears in MASTER_MODEL BASEBALL, where a row below a main lift carries 'Superset - same reps' or 'Superset - max reps' in the reps column with an empty sets cell, and in MASTER_MODEL '05 EXAMPLE ATHLETIC FULL BODY' ('SUPERSET: HEAVY Hex bar Squats directly into 10 Repeat Jump Squat HIGH JUMPs').

observed_prescriptions: AESTHETICS - FULL BODY - 4 DAYS: 3 sets on compounds/calves (rows 3-7, 10-11), 2 sets on biceps and leg extensions (rows 8-9), 5 sets on 'DB Push press' (row 13).
JUSTICE LEAGUE (athletic, tracking tab): 2 sets on every filled slot (plyo, throw, COD, triple extension, squat, rows, lunges, pull-ups, leg extensions).
sets.notes: Sets are per exercise per session, not per muscle per week - there is no weekly-volume column anywhere in BYOP. 1-8 is the full menu; 9+ sets in one exercise is not offered.

options.definition_observed_elsewhere: MASTER_MODEL 'ALL ABOUT SQUATS' A30 (verbatim-paraphrase): 15 reps, then without racking pause ~3 s, 5 reps, breathe ~3 s, repeat for 5 mini-sets of 5 = 40 total reps; B27 '15/5/5/5/5/5' labelled C27 '**MYO SET - ADVANCED'. MASTER_MODEL '4 TRACKS' W61: '2 sets LEG PRESS MYO - 15-5-5-5-5-5'.
options.notes: Total reps per MYO SET = 40 (15 activation + 5x5). Coach uses it on machine/isolation quad work (leg extensions, leg press).

bucket_inferred.6 to 8 Reps: strength-hypertrophy; also the coach's default for power/athletic drills (plyos, COD, cleans in JUSTICE LEAGUE)
bucket_inferred.15 Reps: high-rep hypertrophy (calves, leg press, pulldowns, DB deadlifts, push-ups in AESTHETICS)
bucket_inferred.20 Reps: small-muscle / isolation (EZ curls, leg extensions in AESTHETICS)

observed_prescriptions: AESTHETICS: calves 3x'15 Reps'; leg press 3x'15 Reps'; bent-over barbell rows 3x'8 to 12 Reps'; reverse lunges 3x'8 to 12 Reps'; lat pulldown 3x'15 Reps'; EZ-bar curls 2x'20 Reps'; leg extensions 2x'20 Reps'; DB deadlifts 3x'15 Reps'; push-ups 3x'15 Reps'; DB push press 5x'6 to 8 Reps'.
JUSTICE LEAGUE: plyos/COD/power clean/front squat 2x'6 to 8 Reps'; situps-to-overhead-throw, rows, FFE lunges, pull-ups 2x'8 to 12 Reps'; leg extensions 2x'MYO SET'.
ATHLETIC - FULL BODY - 4 DAYS A: G12 leg extensions = 'MYO SET'.
gaps_vs_coach_stated_model: Coach says people pick between 5 and 30 reps: menu tops out at 20 (no 25 / 30) and starts at 4 (no 1-3 for max strength).

No per-side notation (e.g. '8/8' or '12/12') - in MASTER_MODEL those strings were auto-converted by Google Sheets into dates (e.g. BASEBALL F34 = 2022-08-08, C36 = 2022-12-12), so a generator must store reps as text, never as a date-parsable string.
No time (seconds) or distance options, so core holds, carries, drags, cardio and functional (Pallof) holds have no rep vocabulary; the cardio rows in every tab simply have no REPS dropdown.
No RIR/RPE target, rest interval, tempo or load (%1RM) field - although MASTER_MODEL 'ALL ABOUT SQUATS' prescribes '(1 RIR) RPE 8+', rest '1-2 MIN' (hypertrophy) vs '3-6 MIN' (strength).

scale.label: That was terrible
scale.generator_action_inferred: regress load / reduce volume next session

effort.observed_usage_in_program_tabs: none - every EFFORT cell is still a placeholder

interpretation.observed: 10-point client self-report, one per exercise row, logged after the sets. 1 and 2 share the label 'Way Too Easy'. Score 8 is labelled 'That was perfect' while 9 is 'That was terrible' and 10 "I'm done".
interpretation.inferred: It is an RPE-style scale whose bullseye is 8 (= ~1-2 reps in reserve), matching MASTER_MODEL 'ALL ABOUT SQUATS' A13/D13 '(1 RIR) *RPE8+'. So it is NOT 'higher is better': 9-10 means the set overshot. A generator can use it as the autoregulation signal for the week-to-week 3/5/7 % volume or load increments the coach describes: <=6 -> push, 7-8 -> keep/progress slowly, 9-10 -> back off.

scale.generator_action_inferred: keep the slot/category but swap variation (different loading position, grip, stance) - same library column
remove or regress the exercise, reduce sets for that muscle (coach: fewer sets with injury/pain)
regress one level inside the same category (e.g. ADVANCED -> FOUNDATIONAL block, or assisted version)

feeling.notes: Library header is 'FEELING'; the program tabs label the same dropdown 'HOW IT FELT?'. It is a target-tissue + pain screen (mind-muscle connection), not a mood scale. Cardio/Aerobic Capacity rows have EFFORT but no HOW IT FELT? dropdown.

other_logging_columns_in_program_tabs.note: Observed entries are notes/cues ('LATERAL', 'SINGLE ARM') and a pain flag ('OUCH'), not loads - clients/coach use it as a comment field.

other_logging_columns_in_program_tabs.type: checkbox (TRUE/FALSE booleans, one per day block)
other_logging_columns_in_program_tabs.conditional_format: TRUE -> 57BB8A green fill across the day's rows; FALSE -> theme accent 5 fill
other_logging_columns_in_program_tabs.note: Session-completion tracker; merged per day in the NO ACCESS tabs.

related_dosing_elsewhere_observed: MASTER_MODEL 'ALL ABOUT SQUATS' A13-F27: HYPERTROPHY FOCUSED (1 RIR, RPE8+) set x rep menu 3x15, 3x12, 3x10, 3x8, 4x15, 4x12, 4x10, 4x8, then 4x15, 4x12, 4x10, 5x8 each 'Whatever + Max air squats', and 3 x '15/5/5/5/5/5' (MYO SET - ADVANCED); STRENGTH FOCUSED (1 RIR, RPE 8+) 5x3, 6x3, 5x4, 6x4, 7x3, 6x4, 8x2, 7x2, 4x4, 4x5, 5x5, 6x4; rest 1-2 min (hypertrophy) vs 3-6 min (strength); ATHLETIC FOCUSED 'OFF SEASON', 'FRENCH CONTRAST' 3/3/3/3/3.

MASTER_MODEL 'ALL ABOUT SQUATS' A5: 'Modify sets/reps as you want, just don't go too far into changing it, you may ruin the stimulus'; A6: 'Follow the RIR prescription - REPS IN RESERVE - You will also see RPE'.
inferred_fields_note: Everything under keys ending in '_inferred', 'bucket_inferred', 'interpretation.inferred' and 'meaning_inferred' is analyst inference; option text, cells, header rows, wiring and usage counts are observed.
